evals.prompt: Build me a list of 20 heads of growth at Series A SaaS companies in Germany and France with verified emails
assertions: Writes the ICP back and gets a yes before spending
Uses people_search with titles, company_headcount and locations
Passes waterfall.max_cost_for_all as max_cost on contact_find and other lookups
Verifies every email with contact_verify
Gives one line of reason per row
Calls get_operation_pricing before the first paid call of each tool
Sets max_cost on every paid call
Reports the total spent from list_runs
